upstreams.name: OpenScience
upstreams.integration: Upstream history retained; EarthNano shared execution core and opt-in ACP driver added; TaskAgentPort dispatch extracted with legacy behavior preserved; frozen candidate snapshots and isolated Claude Code native preparation composed through the shared ACP driver (opt-in); opt-in persistent optimization composition reuses original Session, immutable ArtifactVersion and scoped Review owners; desktop opt-in task UI now uses typed native commands, shared progress/admission/stop ownership and independent fixed-artifact semantic Reviews; original Session/Artifact/Review owners retained for bounded concurrent candidates; typed desktop method controls and fixed base1 independent comparison added; round7 adds opt-in experiment-local domain input/results and deterministic JSON checks in original scoped Review, with separate artifact/configuration outcomes and no automatic publication; round8 routes desktop Send and headless Task dispatch through the same ExecutionCore as optimization, preserves full rich ACP requests and original Session/ArtifactVersion/Review/delegation owners, and links ordinary Reviewer and background delegated missions through explicit shared-core resource declarations; round9 reuses original Notebook/Artifact/Upload/Reviewer owners for real scientific workflow acceptance and resolves same-Session immutable ArtifactVersion inputs through original managed-version leases; no scientific tool or persistence owner was replaced; round10 extracts the original ACP Notebook binding for ordinary Send and isolated scientific candidates, freezes original managed source versions and enabled Python binding, and reuses the same application Notebook RPC/input/permission/producer owners with narrow host binding and restrictive policy hooks; same original scientific task enters Harness2 baseline and candidates through the existing ExecutionCore; scientific artifact export uses original MCP-published versions, not the text importer

upstreams.name: Harness²
upstreams.integration: EarthNano generated execution contract and method execution seam integrated across schedule, recursion, proposal and selection; legacy remains default; tree records original upstream baseline, not current vendor tree; private JSONL binding now runs original single-mode sequential/parallel method (k 1–8) through common ExecutionCore with pinned results and claude-text profile; round6 leaves existing core algorithm/seam files unchanged and exposes original finals-only anonymous selector; round7 adds a separate opt-in domain entry reusing original task_stream/run_domain, reflect_adoption and Library; raw experience stays experiment-local, with immutable platform provenance; original core modules and single-task earthnano.py unchanged this round; round8 retains optimization algorithms, anonymous selection/reflection/Library/domain ordering and independent grading separation; only shared schema/validator changes permit unbounded ordinary execution deadlines while optimization deadlines remain mandatory; round9 preserves algorithms and adds k3/k8 and four-task Library equivalence coverage while aligning bounded private evidence transport to legal candidate outputs; candidate tools/data profile is unchanged; round10 preserves original schedule/recursion/selection/reflection/Library and upstream pins; private earthnano entry transports fixed Notebook managed-input metadata without changing the original task prompt, keeps all method and independent Reviewer roles workspace-only, and preserves the host-fixed scientific profile across revisions; scientific domain successors are explicitly rejected until separately integrated
